# 3VB

> > 3VB is a leading barristers' chambers specializing in commercial litigation, dispute resolution, and financial crime with expertise across banking, fraud, and international arbitration.

3VB chambers, located at 3 Verulam Buildings in London, comprises King's Counsel and specialist barristers providing commercial legal services to clients globally. The chambers is recognized by major legal directories including Chambers & Partners and Legal 500 for its Band 1 rankings in commercial dispute resolution and civil fraud.

## Key Topics

- Commercial Litigation
- Dispute Resolution
- Banking & Finance
- Civil Fraud
- Commercial Law
- International Arbitration
- Financial Crime
- Chancery Commercial
- Asset Recovery
- Regulatory Compliance
- King's Counsel (KC)
- Barristers Chambers
- Cryptoassets & Blockchain
- Insolvency
- Public International Law

## Practice Areas & Expertise

- [Expertise](https://3vb.com/areas): 3VB practice areas and expertise directory
- [Commercial Dispute Resolution](https://3vb.com/area/commercial-dispute-resolution): 3VB commercial dispute resolution: banking, finance, and litigation
- [Banking & Finance](https://3vb.com/area/banking-finance): 3VB banking and finance litigation: high-value disputes and regulation
- [Civil Fraud](https://3vb.com/area/civil-fraud): 3VB civil fraud and asset recovery: Band 1 commercial litigation
- [Chancery Commercial](https://3vb.com/area/chancery-commercial): 3VB chancery commercial law: fraud, insolvency, and trust disputes
- [Cyber Fraud & Cryptoassets](https://3vb.com/area/cyber-fraud-cryptoassets): 3VB crypto fraud and blockchain disputes: digital assets litigation
- [Art & Cultural Property](https://3vb.com/area/art-cultural-property): 3VB art and cultural property law: litigation and restitution expertise
